hypothesis: WP508 can currently mint a provenance witness tying a recipient CellInput to an exact BroadcastEnvelope even when the CellInput input_refs contain none of the broadcast candidate_payload_refs. Recipient membership plus object identity therefore does not yet establish content-level re-entry provenance.
counterhypothesis: WP508 intentionally witnesses only structural recipient/lineage identity and content-level payload reference binding is guaranteed by another exact upstream/downstream invariant, making an explicit overlap check redundant.
direct_source_evidence: BroadcastEnvelope canonically carries candidate_payload_refs derived from WorkspaceSelection.selected payload_ref values.
WP508 _assert_exact_object_lineage checks plan/input validity, selection-plan/frame identity, broadcast-selection/plan identity, positive reentry_depth and recipient membership.
No observed WP508 check requires any cell_input.input_refs entry to match any broadcast.candidate_payload_refs entry before build_reentry_witness constructs the witness.
minimal_counterexample: Build a valid one-candidate BroadcastEnvelope addressed to G1 with candidate_payload_refs=('payload:broadcast-candidate',). Build a valid G1 CellInput with reentry_depth=1 but input_refs=('payload:unrelated-local-state',). The preregistered test requires build_reentry_witness to reject this as lacking broadcast payload binding.

executed_evidence.interpretation_boundary: The connector exposes step-level failure but not the raw pytest traceback. This is executed negative evidence consistent with the preregistered gap, not yet an assertion that the precise DID-NOT-RAISE traceback was independently inspected. Canonical WP508 ownership should inspect/reproduce the exact test output before repair reconciliation.

impact_if_confirmed: WP508 remains useful for exact structural lineage but cannot claim that the witnessed CellInput re-entered content offered by the bound broadcast. This is narrower than semantic uptake/causal influence and does not invalidate WP506 broadcast construction.
recommended_repair_if_confirmed: On the sole WP508 mutation-authority lane, fail closed unless at least one exact CellInput input_ref is contained in the bound BroadcastEnvelope candidate_payload_refs, or define and enforce a stronger explicit deterministic content-binding relation if one-to-one overlap is not the intended ABI.
Add positive and unrelated-payload negative regressions without weakening recipient/frame/plan/selection/broadcast identity fences.
Do not treat payload-reference overlap as semantic uptake or causal influence; it establishes only content-reference re-entry provenance.
next_exact_action: Canonical WP508 G1 owner should inspect/reproduce the exact failing test output. If the unrelated-payload input is admitted, add the smallest deterministic broadcast-content binding fence on the existing WP508 lane and rerun both canonical WP508 tests and this falsifier; otherwise record the stronger pre-existing invariant that invalidates the counterexample.
